title: Returning Generic Iterators
goal: Order the lazy iterator pipeline returned as `impl Iterator`.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: impl Trait

interaction.fixed_prefix:
fn process_numbers(nums: &[i32]) -> impl Iterator<Item = i32> + '_ {
    nums

hints: Slices do not implement filter directly. Convert the slice into an iterator first.
The closure in filter expects a reference to the iterator item type.
explanation: Calling `.iter()` converts the slice reference into an iterator. Filtering positive values next ensures map only operates on positive elements. Returning `impl Iterator` avoids extra vector allocations.
